summary: Implemented and executed a deterministic Playwright/Chromium GitHub Actions runner for the José V12 LAB candidate. The runner preserves the pinned V11 contract, records machine-readable evidence and screenshots, and now fails fast on the candidate's fail-closed state. Two representative-browser runs proved the immutable V11 gzip+base64 payload is itself corrupted at the pinned source commit: HTTP 200 returns literal [...ELLIPSIZATION...] in the base64 body, so the V12 candidate correctly aborts before loading V11. No product authority pointers were changed.
tests: CI_WORKFLOW_BOOTSTRAP: PASS — checkout, Node, Chromium installation and exact-checkout HTTP serving succeeded.
STATIC_PIN_CONTRACT: PASS — runner asserts source commit 158357fe4e1cb672e4574d9ebe6f317b9418a30f and expected V11 SHA-256 0cf9a40fb53e977dccb40c9755d668a3ee922ccd61883f19229bb4a113139a05.
RAW_SOURCE_TRANSPORT: FAIL — direct GitHub Actions fetch returned HTTP 200, 19886 compact characters, modulo-4=2, with literal [...ELLIPSIZATION...] beginning at compact offset 9865.
RUNTIME_FAIL_CLOSED: PASS — representative Chromium observed InvalidCharacterError at atob() and status 'fail-closed · sin uso del candidato'; no false runtime PASS was inferred.
EVIDENCE_UPLOAD: PASS — bounded evidence.json + failure screenshot uploaded for both runs; run 2 artifact digest sha256:1dda250095e73db80fb80773e9a36819dd666982a4afe86c1887f2e33f609275.
NO_PRODUCT_AUTHORITY_MUTATION: PASS — no Catalog, Current, Lineage, Human Accepted or Served pointer changed.
unresolved: The exact missing V11 payload bytes are not present in the scoped LAB/material directory. A repair must recover bytes that reproduce the recorded SHA-256 exactly; guessing or rebuilding a merely equivalent V11 would violate the pinned-source contract.
Topic-local rail/12-level/3-round and V12/V11 A/B runtime assertions remain unreachable until the pinned V11 material is recovered.
spawn_note: No successor was fabricated because scoped archaeology found no exact recoverable copy of the missing V11 bytes. The failure is durably evidenced; an exact-source recovery should be materialized only when a grounded byte source becomes available.
